type F = (<T = number>(x: T) => T) | (<T = string>(x: T) => T);
function use(f: F) { return f(1); }
type G = (<T>(x: T) => T) | (<T = number>(x?: T) => T);
function use2(g: G) { return g("x"); }
type H = (<T extends string>(x: T) => T) | (<T extends number>(x: T) => T);
function use3(h: H) { return h("x" as never); }
type K = (<T = number>(x: T) => T[]) | (<T = string>(x: T) => T);
function use4(k: K) { const r: null = k(1); }
type L = (<T = number>(x: T) => T) | (<T = string>(x: T) => T) | (<T = boolean>(x: T, y?: T) => T);
function use5(l: L) { const r: null = l(true); }
console.log(use((x) => x), use2((x) => x));
